title: Fix same toLocaleDateString hydration issue in PurchasesPageContent.tsx
body: The list page at `src/app/(frontend)/account/purchases/PurchasesPageContent.tsx` has the same `formatDate` function using `toLocaleDateString` which could cause similar hydration mismatches. Apply the same deterministic formatter fix.
rationale: Same root cause as #2411. The list page might also exhibit hydration mismatches under certain timezone/ICU configurations.
